title: Centric Relation: Science, Myth or Clinical Convenience?
html: Preserve a suitable existing bite, or select centric relation or a reliably recorded functional reference to establish stable, reproducible maximum intercuspation. Optional freedom in centric is deliberately designed, clinically bounded tooth-contact tolerance at unchanged bite height, not a physiological jaw pathway: reference contact and intended maximum intercuspation define its limits when different; no discrepancy is needed when they coincide, and superior clinical outcomes remain unproven.
